title: Member discount
goal: Intended change: the 5% member discount now applies only to orders whose total (price * qty) is at least 100. Keep collecting the discounts in pct. Everything else must behave as before; if part of the refactoring cannot behave as before, change that part.

keep.desc: the member discount is conditional on the order total: member == 1 && total >= 100
the discounts are still collected in pct
